name: PSLE Oral English Practice
subject: english
description: Training rubric for PSLE-style English oral practice. This is not an official SEAB marking scheme.

criteria.name: Reading Aloud Delivery
criteria.description: Assesses oral reading clarity, pronunciation, fluency, pacing, expression, and awareness of purpose, audience, and context when reading aloud. If only a transcript is available, score conservatively and focus on observable evidence.

rubric_levels.description: Clear, confident reading with accurate pronunciation, smooth pace, expressive tone, and strong awareness of purpose and audience
Mostly clear and fluent reading with minor pronunciation, pacing, or expression lapses
Understandable reading with uneven pace, limited expression, or several pronunciation issues
Halting or unclear reading with frequent pronunciation, fluency, or expression difficulties
No reading attempt or no usable evidence for this component

criteria.name: Stimulus Response Relevance
criteria.description: Assesses whether the student answers the oral prompt directly, uses relevant details from the stimulus or passage, and gives a clear personal response.

rubric_levels.description: Direct, focused response with relevant stimulus details and a clear personal viewpoint
Mostly relevant response with some stimulus reference and personal response
Partly relevant response, but stimulus details or personal viewpoint are thin
Limited relevance or mostly generic response
No meaningful answer to the prompt

criteria.name: Idea Development
criteria.description: Assesses elaboration, examples, reasons, opinions, and ability to extend answers beyond one-word or one-sentence responses.

rubric_levels.description: Well-developed ideas with reasons, examples, and thoughtful extension
Clear ideas with some useful reasons or examples
Basic ideas with limited elaboration
Very brief or underdeveloped answer
No developed idea

criteria.name: Spoken Language Use
criteria.description: Assesses grammar, sentence control, vocabulary range, and suitability of spoken English for a Primary 6 oral response.

rubric_levels.description: Accurate, varied language with precise vocabulary and natural spoken expression
Generally accurate language with appropriate vocabulary and minor errors
Understandable language with simple vocabulary and noticeable errors
Frequent language errors or very limited vocabulary affect clarity
No usable spoken language evidence

criteria.name: Interaction And Confidence
criteria.description: Assesses responsiveness to the assessor, willingness to continue speaking, turn-taking, confidence, and ability to build on prompts or guidance.

rubric_levels.description: Responds confidently, stays engaged, and builds naturally on prompts
Responds adequately with some confidence or occasional prompting
Needs repeated support to continue or respond
No meaningful interaction
